response.description:
Azure Site Recovery
now supports replication and disaster recovery for Linux Azure Virtual Machines
running on NVMe-enabled Generation 2 VM families, such as the Da/Ea/Fa
v6-series and Ebsv5/Ebdsv5 in the Azure-to-Azure scenario. This support is
limited to RHEL 9, SLES 15 and Ubuntu 24 distros of Linux. This enhancement
allows customers to enable disaster recovery and replication for their Azure
VMs running high-performance, I/O-intensive workloads (limited to ASR churn
support) with the NVMe disk controller. This capability is supported across all
Azure public cloud regions. Learn more.
response.title: Generally Available: Azure Site Recovery support for Linux Azure VMs with NVMe disk controllers.
